native_mechanisms: Lay both sequences out as aligned rows and count only the positions where the symbols match exactly (offset-0 match count).
Allow the second row to slip forward by exactly one position at a mismatch — a single gap/shift per pass, never two.
Run every single-slip variant as a separate pass, discard passes that would need a second slip, and return the maximum score over all passes.
core_technique: Full Needleman-Wunsch global alignment DP computed on anti-diagonal wavefronts with three rolling score vectors and an AVX2 SIMD inner loop (reversed b for contiguous loads).
